mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q01.stem: Oxidation loses electrons and reduction gains them.
reasons: True is correct. The electron-releasing side is oxidized and the receiving side reduced.
False is inappropriate. The electron-releasing side is oxidized and the receiving side reduced.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q02.stem: Dissolved constituents can remain even after filtration gives clarity.
reasons: True is correct. A filter is not a device removing every dissolved component.
False is inappropriate. A filter is not a device removing every dissolved component.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q03.stem: Increasing force improves dimensional accuracy for every material.
reasons: True is incorrect. Excessive force can overremove corners or dimensions.
False is correct. Excessive force can overremove corners or dimensions.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q04.stem: Clear wastewater may still need analysis of dissolved constituents.
reasons: True is correct. Harmful dissolved constituents can remain in clear liquid.
False is inappropriate. Harmful dissolved constituents can remain in clear liquid.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q05.stem: Every textbook chemical can always be used regardless of current regulations.
reasons: True is incorrect. Current regulations and customer specifications need separate comparison.
False is correct. Current regulations and customer specifications need separate comparison.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q06.stem: Comparison with nondefective items under the same conditions also aids investigation.
reasons: True is correct. Condition differences from normal items can help narrow causes.
False is inappropriate. Condition differences from normal items can help narrow causes.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q07.stem: Mass percentage and mol/L can interchange as the same number without other information.
reasons: True is incorrect. Conversion needs conditions such as molar mass and density.
False is correct. Conversion needs conditions such as molar mass and density.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q08.stem: Matching specific gravity means different liquids have identical constituent concentrations.
reasons: True is incorrect. Different constituent combinations can have the same specific gravity.
False is correct. Different constituent combinations can have the same specific gravity.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q09.stem: Ask the responsible person when two documents contradict.
reasons: True is correct. Do not fill gaps independently; check the valid documents.
False is inappropriate. Do not fill gaps independently; check the valid documents.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q10.stem: An operator can choose whichever standard guide or product requirement is convenient.
reasons: True is incorrect. Conflicting requirements require valid-document and responsible-person checks.
False is correct. Conflicting requirements require valid-document and responsible-person checks.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q11.stem: A clear liquid can still contain dissolved constituents.
reasons: True is correct. Dissolved constituents exist even when invisible.
False is inappropriate. Dissolved constituents exist even when invisible.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q12.stem: Knowing the different metal names determines corrosion rates in every environment.
reasons: True is incorrect. Coating, area, liquid and temperature conditions also influence rates.
False is correct. Coating, area, liquid and temperature conditions also influence rates.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q13.stem: Separate suspect items from conforming ones before causes are established.
reasons: True is correct. Preventing suspect-item escape is necessary even with unknown causes.
False is inappropriate. Preventing suspect-item escape is necessary even with unknown causes.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q14.stem: A correct measurement method permits skipping planned lots.
reasons: True is incorrect. The target and frequency are also control-plan conditions.
False is correct. The target and frequency are also control-plan conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q15.stem: Convert volume first when using cm³ and mm³.
reasons: True is correct. A length conversion affects three dimensions in volume.
False is inappropriate. A length conversion affects three dimensions in volume.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q16.stem: Accelerated-test time and actual service life are not identical.
reasons: True is correct. Actual wet/dry cycling, damage and other conditions differ.
False is inappropriate. Actual wet/dry cycling, damage and other conditions differ.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q17.stem: Acidic oxides are classified as reacting only with acids.
reasons: True is incorrect. This reverses the reaction partners of acidic and basic oxides.
False is correct. This reverses the reaction partners of acidic and basic oxides.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q18.stem: Identical automated movements permit permanently omitting quality inspection.
reasons: True is incorrect. Automatic operations still experience wear or unsuitable conditions.
False is correct. Automatic operations still experience wear or unsuitable conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q19.stem: Specify the reaction when using equivalent concentration.
reasons: True is correct. Equivalents depend on the reference reaction.
False is inappropriate. Equivalents depend on the reference reaction.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q20.stem: Near-miss information can help prevent accidents.
reasons: True is correct. It helps prevent small hazards from being ignored.
False is inappropriate. It helps prevent small hazards from being ignored.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q21.stem: The same term corrosion resistance makes alkali-drop and salt-spray tests equivalent.
reasons: True is incorrect. Alkali resistance and corrosion resistance in saltwater address different evaluations.
False is correct. Alkali resistance and corrosion resistance in saltwater address different evaluations.
True is incorrect. 1 cm is 10 mm, so 1 cm³ is 1000 mm³.
False is correct. 1 cm is 10 mm, so 1 cm³ is 1000 mm³.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q23.stem: Check specified materials and ratios for two-component paints.
reasons: True is correct. Bases and hardeners have product-specific instructions.
False is inappropriate. Bases and hardeners have product-specific instructions.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q24.stem: QC process charts include measurement frequencies and abnormality responses.
reasons: True is correct. Read what is controlled, when, by whom and what to do if abnormal.
False is inappropriate. Read what is controlled, when, by whom and what to do if abnormal.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q25.stem: Density calculations alone establish safe lifting gear and solo handling.
reasons: True is incorrect. Lifting also requires actual weight, center of gravity and equipment capacity checks.
False is correct. Lifting also requires actual weight, center of gravity and equipment capacity checks.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q26.stem: 80 mV has the same value as 80 V.
reasons: True is incorrect. 80 mV=0.080 V.
False is correct. 80 mV=0.080 V.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q27.stem: Read acid strength separately from concentration.
reasons: True is correct. Dissociation degree and solute concentration have different meanings.
False is inappropriate. Dissociation degree and solute concentration have different meanings.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q28.stem: Copy the numeric N result directly into mol/L.
reasons: True is incorrect. Check the reaction and equivalent definition for mol/L conversion.
False is correct. Check the reaction and equivalent definition for mol/L conversion.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q29.stem: Strong-electrolyte classification does not mean high concentration.
reasons: True is correct. Strength concerns dissociation, not concentration itself.
False is inappropriate. Strength concerns dissociation, not concentration itself.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-theory-q30.stem: m in mA always has the same role as standalone m.
reasons: True is incorrect. Standalone m means metre; m in mA means milli.
False is correct. Standalone m means metre; m in mA means milli.
